body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success, deal 1 Psychic damage, make it Dazed, and remove Rallied from it if present.

surges.html: The target cannot make Reactions against the next creature you designate before your next turn.
Mark one affected creature; your next Psionics Action against it gains 1 free Surge, then remove the mark.

rider.title: FRACTURE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the target also burns 1 die on its next Reaction.
